releases.name: ds-saver 0.4.3
releases.body:
## ds-saver 0.4.3

OpenCode / DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的上下文与成本节约插件。0.4.3 通过 npm Trusted Publishing（OIDC）发布，无运行时变更。

### 安装

```sh
# DSH
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ds-saver

# npm
npm install ds-saver

# OpenCode 一键包（插件 + 3 skills + 计量/RAG 工具）
git clone https://github.com/T1113047/ds-saver.git
cd ds-saver
DS_SAVER_WORKSPACE=/path/to/your/workspace ./install.sh
```

### 这个版本包含

- **0.4.3**：GitHub Actions OIDC 自动发布、Community Market 部署说明。
- **0.4.2**：LF 行尾修复，Linux/macOS 的 `bundle/install.sh` 不再因 CRLF 失败。
- **0.4.1 / 0.4.0**：Windows shim 修复、包内 `ctx-usage.py`、Python 3.9+ 回退、DSH 零依赖适配、`rag(filter=true)`。

### 验证

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5` 全新 headless profile：`tree` / `rag(filter=true)` / `misc` / `handoff` 均由模型实际调用。
- npm `latest = 0.4.3`；`0.4.1` 已 deprecate（CRLF）。
- 详细记录：https://github.com/T1113047/ds-saver/blob/main/docs/dsh-verification.md

### 不会调试？

把 `README.md`、`bundle/README.md`、`docs/dsh-verification.md` 直接喂给 AI；`bundle/` 一键安装包内含 3 个预置 skill 提示词（`local-index-rag` / `opencode-rag` / `make-decision`）。

### 资产

- `ds-saver-0.4.3.tgz`（npm 包，31 files）

releases.name: ds-saver 0.4.1
releases.body:
## ds-saver 0.4.1

Context/token saver for OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

### Install

```sh
# DSH
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ds-saver

# OpenCode: one-click bundle (plugin + 3 skills + metering/RAG tools)
git clone https://github.com/T1113047/ds-saver.git
cd ds-saver
DS_SAVER_WORKSPACE=/path/to/your/workspace ./install.sh
```

### What is new

- **0.4.0**: `bundle/` one-click installer, bundled `ctx-usage.py` (no workspace script), Python 3.9+ detection with `python3` → `python` fallback, `--db` / `DS_SAVER_OPENCODE_DB` support, Windows shim fix.
- **0.3.0**: `rag(filter=true)` selects 3-5 candidates with a cheap model before injecting them; failures fall back to raw hits.
- **0.2.1**: DSH adapter no longer imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`; linked/local/npm installs all load.

### Verified

- DSH `0.2.2-rc.5`, fresh headless profiles: `tree`, `rag(filter=true)`, `misc`, `handoff` called by the model.
- npm install and `dsh plugin add ds-saver` both install `0.4.1` from the registry.
- Details: https://github.com/T1113047/ds-saver/blob/main/docs/dsh-verification.md

### 不会调试？

把 `README.md`、`bundle/README.md`、`docs/dsh-verification.md` 直接喂给 AI；`bundle/` 一键安装包内含 3 个预置 skill 提示词（`local-index-rag` / `opencode-rag` / `make-decision`）。

### Links

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-saver
- Catalog: https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/pull/1124
- Article: https://github.com/T1113047/ds-saver/blob/main/docs/article-dsh-fresh-install.md
